name: Bandtastic: Bollinger-band lower-band entry with optional RSI/MFI/EMA filters
one_line: Buy when close < chosen lower Bollinger band (1-4 sigma), optionally RSI/MFI/EMA-trend gated; exit on RSI/MFI/EMA/upper band.

source.license: GPL-3.0 (repo LICENSE). Only ideas are summarised here; no code copied.

idea: Pick one of four Bollinger lower bands as trigger; filters are individually switchable by boolean parameters.

rules.name: bb_lower_trigger
rules.description: close < Bollinger lower band k sigma

rules.name: band_rsi_exit
rules.description: close > upper band or RSI/MFI above sell level

evidence: Shipped parameters are hyperopt output (in-sample); no published statistics.
limitations: mean reversion buys falling knives in bear trends

pipeline_fit.notes: Fix 2-sigma band, RSI 30 style a-priori; switchable filters map directly to named RULES.
